dashboard.name: RetailPulse Overview
dashboard.description: Revenue, products, stores, channels, stock alerts and data quality for the RetailPulse platform.

cards.name: Total revenue
cards.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(revenue), 0) AS total_revenue FROM dw.fact_sales

cards.name: Orders
cards.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders FROM dw.fact_sales

cards.name: Average order value
cards.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 0), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM dw.fact_sales

cards.name: Overall reject rate (%)
cards.sql: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(total_rejected) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(total_records), 0), 2), 0) AS reject_pct FROM dw.mart_dq_summary

cards.name: Revenue trend by day
cards.sql: SELECT full_date, SUM(total_revenue) AS revenue FROM dw.mart_daily_revenue GROUP BY full_date ORDER BY full_date

cards.name: Online vs in-store revenue
cards.sql: SELECT channel, SUM(total_revenue) AS revenue FROM dw.mart_channel_performance GROUP BY channel

cards.name: Top 10 products by revenue
cards.sql: SELECT product_name, total_revenue FROM dw.mart_top_products ORDER BY revenue_rank LIMIT 10

cards.name: Sales by category
cards.sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(f.revenue) AS revenue FROM dw.fact_sales f JOIN dw.dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC

cards.name: Store performance
cards.sql: SELECT store_name, SUM(total_revenue) AS revenue FROM dw.mart_channel_performance WHERE channel = 'in_store' GROUP BY store_name ORDER BY revenue DESC

cards.name: Low-stock alerts (latest snapshot)
cards.sql: SELECT product_name, store_name, stock_qty, stock_status FROM dw.mart_low_stock WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM dw.mart_low_stock) ORDER BY stock_qty, product_name LIMIT 25

cards.name: Data-quality scorecard
cards.sql: SELECT source, total_records, total_accepted, total_rejected, overall_reject_pct AS reject_pct FROM dw.mart_dq_summary ORDER BY source

cards.name: Rejected rows by rule
cards.sql: SELECT source || ' / ' || rule_failed AS rule, COUNT(*) AS rows_rejected FROM dq.quarantine GROUP BY source, rule_failed ORDER BY rows_rejected DESC LIMIT 12

cards.name: Recent pipeline events
cards.sql: SELECT created_at, dag_id, task_id, status, LEFT(message, 140) AS message FROM dq.pipeline_events ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 12
